Know the signs

When your car needs attention

Catching a problem early saves money. If you notice any of these, get it checked.

Warning lights on the dash

A check engine or fault light means the car has stored a fault worth reading.

Noise when braking

Grinding, squealing or a soft pedal should be checked straight away.

Rough or hard starting

Shaking, stalling or struggling to start often points to an engine or electrical fault.

Bouncy or loose ride

Knocks over bumps or pulling to one side can mean worn suspension.

Slipping clutch or gears

Revs rising without speed, or hard gear changes, need a proper look.

Overdue for a service

Regular maintenance and tune-ups keep your vehicle in top condition.

FAQ

Common questions

Do you come to me?

Yes. Strive Automotive offers service at your doorstep, plus 24/7 breakdown assistance.

What does diagnostics cost?

Diagnostics and fault finding carry a R350 call out fee. Repairs are quoted after diagnosis.

Which cars do you work on?

Volkswagen, Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Ford, Chevrolet, Toyota, Land Rover and more, petrol and diesel.

Do you do clutch and gearbox replacements?

Yes, along with engine overhauls, suspension, brakes and general mechanical work.

Do I need an appointment?

The workshop is by appointment. Call or WhatsApp +27 67 790 0020 to book a time.
